description: Bounded read-only reader for synthetic design-source tree documents (the G2 synthetic gate). Reads one caller-named tree document (options.designFile) inside the resolved source path and returns the caller-selected subtree (options.designNode) as a design-source snapshot, revision-pinned and never pre-filtered semantically: hidden layers, component instances, decorations and unknown kinds are transported as declared. Dangling child references pass through so the core graph check fails closed. Node budget 100000. Proof ceiling: this is a fixture transport — it carries no provider credentials and performs no network or write operations.
